# OpenFreeMap dark style notice

`apps/mobile/src/theme/openfreemap-dark.json` is the original 47-layer descriptor downloaded on 2026-10-09 from [OpenFreeMap's Dark style](https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/dark), retained with whitespace formatting only. Its sources, sprites, glyphs, layer layout/filter/geometry rules and remote attribution paths are preserved.

`apps/mobile/src/theme/mapStyle.ts` creates a JalNet LOCAL/DEMO presentation variant at module initialization. It changes the background color and text paint colors/halos to JalNet's centralized dark semantic palette after actual emulator review found low-contrast upstream labels. It also supplements source attribution with Dark Matter source/design credits and JalNet's color adaptation. Roads, feature geometry, vector/tile URLs, fonts, sprite paths and label layout remain unchanged. This adaptation is not an upstream style release. The stable JSON descriptor is passed to the existing MapLibre Native renderer; there is no added runtime fetch/cache/provider and no change to the Amazon Location branch. Tiles, glyphs and sprites still need the existing external network access; bundling a style descriptor does not create an offline basemap.

The [OpenFreeMap styles repository](https://github.com/hyperknot/openfreemap-styles) identifies Dark as a fork of [OpenMapTiles Dark Matter](https://github.com/openmaptiles/dark-matter-gl-style), with the upstream layout and Noto Sans fonts. Its complete project/dependency license notice is reproduced in [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md), including Copyright (c) 2023 Zsolt Ero. Dark-specific notices omitted from that general file are preserved in the exact upstream [OPENMAPTILES_DARK_LICENSE.md](OPENMAPTILES_DARK_LICENSE.md).

Dark Matter credits Copyright (c) 2024 MapTiler.com & OpenMapTiles contributors and Copyright (c) 2015 CartoDB Inc. Its code uses BSD 3-Clause; its design uses CC BY 4.0 and derives from CartoDB Basemaps designed by Stamen and Paul Norman for CartoDB Inc. under CC BY 3.0. The included full notices and linked licenses apply to the imported style; JalNet's own MIT license does not replace them.

The reachable native map attribution popup was inspected in both modes and displays OpenFreeMap, [© OpenMapTiles](https://openmaptiles.org/) and [© OpenStreetMap contributors](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). The descriptor's source-attribution string also includes Dark Matter design/license credits and the JalNet color-adaptation notice, but those additional credits were not visible in the inspected native popup. Do not claim otherwise. Preserve the three visible data-source credits in UI/screenshots and distribute these complete design/license notices with app/source materials; include the linked Dark Matter/adaptation credit in descriptions of recorded Dark footage. Source URLs and geometry remain unchanged.

Font, icon and Natural Earth notices remain in LICENSE.md. No private imagery, credentials or real device coordinates are bundled with this style.
